dimensions.issue_validity: Real, well-investigated bug with clear reproduction steps. The author systematically ruled out beads dependency state and narrowed the problem to the sous-chef agent misinterpreting bd show output during the serve phase.
dimensions.actionability: Highly actionable. The sous-chef agent runs bd show as part of context collection and likely misinterprets parent-child dependency listings as real blockers. The fix is scoped to either the sous-chef prompt or the serve command template.
dimensions.project_relevance: Directly relevant. Core loop functionality bug that prevents the automated cook-serve-tidy-plate workflow from making progress.
dimensions.priority_signal: High priority. Makes the entire autonomous loop non-functional with the kiro CLI backend. Every task returns BLOCKED, the circuit breaker trips after 5 consecutive failures.
dimensions.duplicate_check: Not a duplicate of any open issue.

rationale: Well-documented, high-impact bug. The serve phase's sous-chef agent misinterprets parent-child dependencies from bd show as real blockers, causing all tasks to return BLOCKED regardless of actual dependency state. The circuit breaker then halts the loop. Fix is likely scoped to the sous-chef prompt or serve command template.
